title: Adding Four 2-Digit Numbers Word Problems
intro: Teach flexible grouping when adding four two-digit numbers.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Invite the student to look for convenient pairs, then record the intermediate sums. Keep all four original addends visible.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Each row combines two different boxes.
BoxesPair of countsSubtotal
1 and 223 + 4770
3 and 436 + 1450

70 + 50 = 120 counters

The subtotals cover all four boxes. Do not add the original counts again after combining the subtotals.

Ask your student

Which pair would make the next step easier?

If your student needs help

If an addend is used twice or left out, mark each one as it is included.
